x: Berry, writes his thanks for the "Belgravian" which keeps him supplied with news of other members, and at week-ends he often thinks of the enjoyable times he has had. Ray Dunford now in the R.A.F. and stationed in Cornwall.
Ray Dunford with the R.A.F., is probably now on his way overseas. Bill Jones was unable to have his annual spin in the Bradford Walk owing to damaged ribs.

Len Marchant still sends cheery letters from the Azores. He has contacted Ray Dunford who is also in those parts. Will Rispin sends us greetings from the front line with the B.L.A.
